scope: Isolated real ROS DDS/MultiThreadedExecutor with synthetic source-stamped odom, TF, scan, localization/control; no Gazebo or physical driving; no closed-loop success claim.

control_boundary.new_invalid_feedback_or_out_of_certified: zero; new normal 20Hz stamp alone is not invalidation
control_boundary.stop_ack: Exclusive output+core ESTOP+actual published zero; not a physical-standstill claim

delivery_changes: latest-only odom queue and independent tiny feedback lock; FIRSTreceipt captured before lock wait
scan/output/nav/health share a mutually-exclusive application group, leaving /clock, TF and odom executor capacity
busy periodic status snapshots skip rather than occupy a worker waiting for geometry
one prepared full guard per output; original-source final freshness, exact emitted curve and elapsed compute bounds checked before publish
stop/manual-takeover/raw-body ingress can latch zero under a separate publication lock while core admission waits; old computed output cannot follow that zero

only redundant same-owner AUTO heartbeats coalesce; explicit busy resumes retain original payload/stamp/seq/FIRSTreceipt and undergo normal core admission; a newer accepted packet supersedes older deferred input

combined_focused.note: Included a cancelled-timer teardown warning; no test failed. Test-only teardown subsequently leaves cancelled timer destruction until after executor shutdown.

performance_interpretation: 20Hz timer target with observed p95 publication gaps, not a hard-real-time 50ms deadline guarantee. Measured full guard is real callback work; final output also checks source freshness, emitted curve and a <=50ms prepared-proof budget. Near-cap cases use stationary measured feedback; far-clear cases use actual nonzero feedback (.22,.35). Synthetic producer TF is stationary, so this is computational/delivery evidence, not a coherent physical plant replay.
functional_cases: busy geometry + all periodic input groups leaves clock/odom progressing
stop zero published before blocked geometry releases; no old nonzero after stop
busy HOLD->AUTO survives with original packet and later ESTOP wins
later different AUTO owner beats older queued AUTO
duplicate, replay, retired source, malformed/stale/future stop admission and safety-old-stamp exception
FIRSTreceipt before feedback lock wait; duplicate cannot renew
wall overrun, clock jump/rewind, invalid feedback and unexpected feedback jump veto final output; in-bounds new feedback accepted
paused-clock deferred control expires without original receipt renewal
